goal: Make the vacation and event availability sliders deterministic, supplier-authoritative and regression-resistant.

intent_model.literal_request: Compare the vacation and event availability sliders with the old site and then with the API, fix the mismatch and lock it permanently.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Users always see the correct currently available businesses, price, dates and booking mode without cards randomly appearing, disappearing or changing order.
likely_rejections: Only one currently visible tab was fixed
The old site was copied even when its data was stale
The API is correct but the browser changes the order
A test passes while the public card identity or price is wrong

interpretation_rules.phrase: מול האתר הישן ואז מול ה api
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use legacy UI to recover intended labels, windows and presentation, then use the supplier-backed API as current availability truth.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Legacy-only differences must be classified, not blindly reproduced.

interpretation_rules.phrase: לנעול את זה שיעבוד תקין תמיד
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Create a shared pure selection contract and regression audit that fails on nondeterminism, wrong joins or incomplete offers.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A point fix without contract tests is insufficient.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: One stable rail per selected date window showing only complete verified offers.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: The user chooses a named date period; the system chooses the canonical offers deterministically.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the matching business with the exact dates, guests and supplier room or slot.

natural_destination: Homepage and dedicated vacation and event last-minute pages

facts.claim: The public vacation API currently returns complete verified deals for all five named periods.
The current client applies document-seeded orderDiscoveryRail to verified vacation and event offers.
The legacy first rail and current API differ in membership and order.
facts.evidence: Visible legacy homepage slider compared with the public home-deals API

assumptions.claim: The supplier-backed API is the source of truth for current availability and price.
assumptions.validation: Trace route construction and compare complete supplier result fields with rendered card fields.

assumptions.claim: Legacy UI is authoritative only for tab semantics and intended presentation.
assumptions.validation: Classify stale dates and publication differences instead of copying them.

in_scope: Offer completeness, public entity join, deduplication and stable ordering
API-to-render identity, dates, price and booking mode
Desktop and mobile reload and tab-switch verification
out_of_scope: Publishing, DNS or domain changes without separate authorization
CMS, database, schema, secret or permission changes
invariants: No card claims availability without a complete supplier-confirmed offer
Online-bookable vacation offers remain ahead of phone-only available offers
A card price, date and room or slot belong to that exact displayed entity

requirements.statement: Each named tab resolves to the intended deterministic date window in the Israel timezone.
Only complete verified supplier offers joined to published public entities are displayed.
One canonical offer per entity is selected and ordered identically in API and UI.
The contract remains stable across reload, desktop, mobile and future code changes.

acceptance_checks.setup: Clock fixtures before, during and after Thursday and Friday in Asia/Jerusalem
acceptance_checks.action: Resolve all vacation and event tabs
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every tab returns the documented from, till and night count without server/client drift

acceptance_checks.setup: Offers include missing price, unavailable, missing room or slot, unpublished and unknown identities
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every invalid candidate is excluded with no false card

acceptance_checks.setup: Multiple complete offers and duplicate offers for the same entity
acceptance_checks.action: Build API response and rendered rail
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Exactly one canonical offer per entity appears in the same stable order with matching price, dates and booking mode

acceptance_checks.action: Render twice with different document seeds and at desktop and mobile widths
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Card identities, order and commercial fields remain identical

acceptance_checks.setup: Local production build and parity audit
acceptance_checks.action: Switch every tab, reload and open the first card
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The rail remains useful, truthful and links with the exact selected supplier parameters

authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis, source repair and verification are authorized; production publication is excluded until separately authorized.
